Nina Park: Candidate accepted for Staff SWE (IC6). They asked to start Apr 1 but have pre-booked medical procedure Apr 10-18 overseas. They want benefits effective Apr 1 and the 1st half of sign-on (if split) at start. Need to confirm comp band and approvals.
Carlos Mendez: Can you paste comp and location? Also confirm manager sign-off on start date.
Nina Park: Offer: 
```
Base: $240,000
Sign-on: $40,000 (split 50/50 requested)
Band: IC6 (B-IC6-US)
Location: Remote - CA
```
Evelyn Cho: IC6 midpoint $235k. Offer is +2.1% above midpoint. For >2% we prefer a short manager justification. If manager signs off, Comp team can approve without committee.
Carlos Mendez: Manager here. I confirm start Apr 1 and rationale: candidate has unique graph-compiler expertise and will lead a cross-team migration. Approve uplift.
CompBot: @Evelyn Reminder: document rationale in comp record; attach signed offer.
Payroll Bot: Benefits start date follows official start date. Retro enrollment up to 30 days requires documented exception and People Ops approval. Sign-on split is allowed; payroll needs payment schedule + signed offer via payroll@redwood.
Evelyn Cho: OK, approve +2.1% manager-backed. People Ops to file exception: "IC6 +2.1% manager-approved; split sign-on, retro benefits noted."
Nina Park: Candidate insists first 50% needs to be paid on Apr 1. They will be on approved unpaid medical leave Apr 10-18.
Carlos Mendez: Manager confirms this does not affect headcount. Onboarding plan: remote orientation Apr 1-9, then medical leave. Buddy will provide async materials.
Nina Park: I'll open payroll ticket and attach signed offer + note: "pay 50% sign-on on Apr 1; remainder at 6 months." Also will attach medical leave docs if needed.
Payroll Bot: Note: If medical leave is unpaid, service counts from official start date. Payroll will schedule first sign-on tranche in the Apr 1 payroll run if ticket submitted by payroll cutoff (Mar 24). Otherwise payment will process in next cycle. Taxes apply as usual.
Evelyn Cho: Filing the comp-exception record now. People Ops please confirm payroll ticket created.
Nina Park: Ticket opened and cc'd comp/legal. Candidate confirmed. Thanks everyone :partyparrot:
_meta: generated for dataset: people-ops offer approvals and comp bands  split sign-on + benefits start with medical leave
